methods.label: Group four terms at a time
methods.explanation:
The signs repeat in groups of four, suggesting the groups \(1-2-3+4\), \(5-6-7+8\), and so on. In each group, the first number minus the second is \(-1\), while the negative third number plus the fourth is \(1\). Therefore every group sums to
\[
-1+1=0.
\]
Since \(1996=4\cdot499\), all terms belong to 499 complete groups, ending with \(1993-1994-1995+1996\). There are no leftover terms, so the expression equals \(0\), choice \(\mathrm{C}\).
